title: Cristiano Ronaldo Leaves National Team
subtitle: Decision Comes After Coach Jorge Jesus' Press Conference
excerpt: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal's national team
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Forward Cristiano Ronaldo has left Portugal's national team concentration in Copenhagen, where the team will face Denmark in the third round of Group D of the Nations League.

Context of the Decision

Cristiano Ronaldo's decision was made after a press conference. Portugal's team is preparing to face Denmark.

The match between Portugal and Denmark is one of the disputes of the Nations League, a soccer tournament that brings together national teams.

With information from Agência Brasil.
